cc:Work.dc:title: CellPack compression ratios
cc:Work.dc:description: Technical report section 5.3, Table 3. Arithmetic mean of compression ratios with equal weight per raw or normalized matrix block; not total bytes divided by total compressed bytes. CellPack: 432 raw + 302 normalized blocks; general codecs: 428 raw + 296 normalized blocks, different seeded prefixes. Selected configurations from the published summary, not paired-input comparisons. CellPack uses 4096-cell chunks. No decode-speed claim.
